Buffered put is 47% of pure-Blake ops/s — Blake-scale cost may matter.
Memory 1033823 → Discard-Buffered 166826 → Real-Buffered 135510: gap Memory→Discard is **pre-disk store work**; Discard→Real is **tail I/O**.
Raw write_all 996978 ops/s vs Buffered put 135510 — store adds 7.4× wall vs raw same-size writes.
